columns.name: name field; see row notes
columns.value: Measured value or explicit category; never visual magnitude unless numeric and appropriate
columns.sourceLocator: Exact section/table/row in cited primary source
columns.geographicId: ISO 3166 alpha-3 or explicit named area; null for non-geographic records

denominator: Source-defined mean pairwise cross-language concurrence, aggregated over 251 territories; not a population percentage

geography.anchorRule: Abstract sphere cells only. Do not place records on country boundaries.

time.updateCadence: Frozen archival study; new models or benchmark revisions require a separately versioned dataset

sources.publisher: Li et al.; Association for Computational Linguistics
sources.title: This Land is Your, My Land: Evaluating Geopolitical Bias in Language Models through Territorial Disputes
sources.locator: Paper PDF printed p.3860, Table 5, Cst CS (all) column; methods section 4

reuse.basis: ACL Anthology page footer: CC BY 4.0; factual numerical table extraction only
reuse.attribution: Li et al.; Association for Computational Linguistics. This Land is Your, My Land: Evaluating Geopolitical Bias in Language Models through Territorial Disputes. Accessed 2026-10-19.
reuse.notes: Metadata and brief independently written factual records only; no implication of endorsement. Not a claim that the whole source is openly licensed.

coverage.population: Six model rows from BorderLines Table 5; rank-classification protocol; all 251 territories
coverage.included: 6 populated records; Six model rows from BorderLines Table 5; rank-classification protocol; all 251 territories
coverage.omitted: Current 2026 models, per-territory outputs, response probabilities, language-specific sampling counts and any legal adjudication of sovereignty
coverage.missingness: Unlisted entities are missing, not zero.

uncertainty: Historical model versions and source prompts only. The metric measures consistency, not whether an answer is correct; aggregated values conceal which territories or languages disagree. Source table reports no interval. Territorial claims must retain contested status.

transform.description: Manual transcription of factual values/categories; no interpolation, imputation or causal inference.
transform.validation: Each row carries a source locator; categorical values separately label plans, policies and observed events.

verification.method: Read primary source and compare each extracted record to its named source location.

scoring.reason: No universal extremity or impact score is supported by these data.

forecast.reason: No validated forecast was supplied. Policy intentions and planned installations are not predictions.

sourceMetric.name: Consistency concurrence score, all territories
sourceMetric.formula: For each territory t with n language responses, CstCS(t)=sum(i!=j, 100*I(country_i=country_j))/(n*(n-1)); average across territories as reported by the paper.
sourceMetric.direction: Higher means more pairwise consistency, not more accuracy.
sourceMetric.missingPolicy: Only published aggregate rows retained; no imputed individual territory responses.
